summary.text: Mindy Domb is a Democratic state representative from Amherst who has represented the 3rd Hampshire District since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She chairs the Joint Committee on Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Domb took office in the Massachusetts House on January 2, 2019.
She is chair of the Joint Committee on Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery.
